title: liquiditybot — problem / solution
description: Every failure mode as a PROBLEM whose panel shows the live detector and names the SOLUTION mechanism handling it.

options.content:
### Incidents & diagnostics
Each tile is a fault detector paired with the mechanism that handles it. **A calm board is all green** — any amber or red tile is a live problem, so start there. Window: last 24h · refresh 30s.

panels.title: Stale status
panels.description: Seconds since the runner last wrote status. Problem: a frozen runner. Solution: the wedge-guard escalates and the supervisor revives a dead runner.

panels.title: Kraken WS
panels.description: Kraken websocket link. On a drop the engine falls back to REST so trading continues.

panels.title: Stale marks
panels.description: Age of the freshest mark price. Problem: stale quotes. Solution: the mark-freshness gate holds new risk while stops still run.

panels.title: Stale assets held
panels.description: Assets the feed watchdog has quarantined; entries stay blocked until the feed heals.

panels.title: Entries blocked
panels.description: Assets with new entries blocked by the feed watchdog — a solution actively firing.

panels.title: Divergent feeds
panels.description: Assets whose cross-venue books disagree beyond tolerance.

panels.title: Problem · model Brier
panels.description: Live model Brier score (lower is better). Solution: the governor kills the model and queues a retrain when Brier crosses baseline.

panels.title: Baseline Brier
panels.description: The baseline Brier the live model must stay under.

panels.title: Solution · model governor
panels.description: Model governor state: OK, degraded (shrink + throttle), or killed back to the prior.

panels.title: Solution · auto-retrain
panels.description: Auto-retrain queued to replace a degrading champion model.

panels.title: Drift share
panels.description: Share of features whose live distribution has drifted from training. Solution: a retrain re-fits the model.

panels.title: Kelly throttle
panels.description: Kelly size multiplier — position size shrinks toward zero as model confidence falls.

panels.title: Model fallbacks
panels.description: Times inference fell back to the prior — the fail-safe firing.

panels.title: Inference faults
panels.description: Inference errors raised by the model.

panels.title: Contract failures
panels.description: Feature rows that fell outside the model input contract.

panels.title: Retrain failures
panels.description: Auto-retrain jobs that crashed.

panels.title: Calibration gap
panels.description: Expected calibration error — the gap between predicted and realized win rates.

panels.title: Dirty rows dropped
panels.description: Non-finite legacy rows dropped by the ML-015 load backstop before they NaN a fit; 0 means the corpus is clean by construction.

panels.title: Twin rows excluded
panels.description: Synthetic twins of real trades excluded so a taken signal is never double-counted; nonzero is healthy and tracks taken teach-trades.

panels.title: Problem · drawdown
panels.description: Equity drawdown from peak. Solution: the drawdown throttle scales size down and a 15% hard-stop flattens.

panels.title: Heat vs cap
panels.description: Portfolio heat as a share of the CVaR cap. Solution: heat is throttled under the cap.

panels.title: Daily budget used
panels.description: Share of the daily loss budget consumed.

panels.title: Weekly budget used
panels.description: Share of the weekly loss budget consumed.

panels.title: Loss streak
panels.description: Current run of consecutive losing trades. Solution: the per-asset circuit breaker pauses the asset.

panels.title: Breakers tripped
panels.description: Assets currently paused by their circuit breaker.

panels.title: Taper mult
panels.description: Loss-budget taper multiplier — shrinks size as the daily and weekly loss budget is spent.

panels.title: Circuit breaker — paused assets
panels.description: Per-asset circuit-breaker state; hours-left counts down the cool-off.

panels.title: Op-state
panels.description: Central fault authority: armed (trading), degraded (new risk curtailed), or halted.

panels.title: Latched faults
panels.description: Faults currently latched active across the engine.

panels.title: Firewall fault
panels.description: Risk-firewall latched fault — when set it halts all new risk.

panels.title: Cycle wedge
panels.description: Consecutive failed decision cycles. Solution: the runner escalates wedge recovery.

panels.title: Exit-eval failures
panels.description: Failures while evaluating a position's exit path — a position wedging its own escape. Exits are sacred, so any is red.

panels.title: Venue rejects
panels.description: Kraken AddOrder rejects (OM-021).

panels.title: Manipulation suspicion by asset
panels.description: Per-asset manipulation suspicion (painted or spoofed books). Solution: THALES shades size and down-weights those training rows.

panels.title: Firewall clamps by code
panels.description: Which firewall rule (FW-*) is clamping or rejecting most.
